findings.reason: The protected source is the canonical bounding-area plus corner-parity solution. It accumulates each rectangle once, toggles all four corners directly, and makes the two necessary-and-sufficient final conditions explicit with clear geometric names. No candidate is justified.

Metadata consistently identifies public LeetCode problem 391 and its Python isRectangleCover surface. The Reference preserves positive-area axis-aligned rectangles, exact cover without gaps or overlap, all three source examples with complete explanations, all four constraints, and the coordinate roles.

The immutable native source remains tied to verified submission 2064684619. Its extrema, summed area, corner toggles, outer-corner set, outer area, and joint final predicate are exactly the protected app-local algorithm apart from the LeetCode wrapper and annotations.

The legal 64-, 192-, and 512-strip perfect covers span 8x in rectangle count and force a full accepting pass within all coordinate and count bounds. The current source passes all 11 executions at +0.03 relative growth and 1.00x; correct pairwise overlap checking plus bounding-area equality passes every benchmark output but fails only scaling at +1.01 and 66.97x.

The Approach accurately derives the only possible bounding rectangle, corner parity, area equality, their combined sufficiency, expected O(r) time, O(r) unmatched-corner space, and the sweep-line and pairwise alternatives.

The hash-bound public Reference remains source-fidelity verified, including all three source examples and explanations, equivalent accessible representations of all three source images, gap and overlap distinctions, coordinate semantics, and all four constraints.
